instructions: Read the complete policy, then apply it to the independent checkpoints using the listed fixed commands. Read each complete case with read_case before its operations, including ledger cases. Real disposable repos and CLI consumers are used. Supplied hosted facts, review judgement and PR opening are controlled dependencies; no hosted operation occurs. A later local-floor call separately checks artifact consumption. Persist actual results with submit_result, answer each question, then finish. Result formats list required fields; any additional claims must be supported by supplied facts or observed outputs.

evidence_diagnostic: verification (actual verify-return stdout, or null when not invoked)

tools.name: read_policy
tools.description: Read the unchanged policy in bounded chunks. Start at offset 0, then use each returned next_offset until it is null. Complete policy delivery is required before workflow operations. No scratch file is needed.

tools.name: read_case
tools.description: Read the complete input for one case before its operations. Returns the unchanged full case row, including source facts and fixed command arguments.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Execute one listed fixed command or controlled handoff. CLI nonzero is a normal captured result. Empty input except commands needing JSON stdin. No arbitrary argv or shell.

tools.name: submit_result
tools.description: Record the structured caller result with actual captured output strings.

tools.name: read_ledger
tools.description: Read the existing command-created ledger for an independent case.

tools.name: write_ledger
tools.description: Merge a producer-field patch into the actual ledger. Command-owned and unknown fields are refused and recorded as errors.

tools.name: append_event
tools.description: Execute the real pinned events append CLI with the supplied JSON payload on stdin. Every invocation includes --run and --root for this case; token-tagged invocations also include --tokens and --session-id. Flag order is free; no other flags. For ledger edits use transition_id ledger-edit; for phase observations use their supplied id.

rule_questions.question: A dispatched graft has green gates and complete returned evidence. Return {"lane_merges":boolean,"token":string}.
One automatically checked criterion passes; another is explicitly needs-human and has not been verified. Return {"all_verified":boolean,"mark_human_passed":boolean}.
The real gate call is incomplete with exit3. Return {"emit_quality_contract":boolean,"resume":boolean,"repeat_completed_units":boolean}.
May a dispatcher record raw pr-ready as a terminal ledger outcome? Return {"terminal":boolean}.
Graft returns retry-later after mandatory review outage. Return {"bucket":string,"annotation":string}.
An actual digest return matches on-disk bytes. Does that alone prove schema conformance or factual verification? Return {"schema_proven":boolean,"facts_proven":boolean}.
